issues.description: Method parameter type mismatch for addGuestStudents: the problem statement text (task description) declares addGuestStudents(String) while the UML diagram and the reference implementation define addGuestStudents(int). Specifically, problem_statement.md line 49 instructs "addGuestStudents(String)", whereas the UML in problem_statement.md line 73 lists "+addGuestStudents(int): void" and the solution implementation defines the method as "public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)" (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 90). This contradiction can confuse students about which parameter type to implement and may lead to a non-matching signature compared to the provided UML/tests and the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type for addGuestStudents consistent across all artifacts. Preferably update the problem statement task text at problem_statement.md line 49 to request addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML (line 73) and the reference implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 90). If the intended design truly requires a String parameter, instead update the UML and reference implementation to use String and add clarification on how the String should be parsed/handled. Ensure the task description, UML, and solution/tests all use the same signature.
